info.title: Diskograf API
info.description:
A public, read-only REST API over the Diskograf catalogue of Malaysian music.

Public endpoints require no authentication and expose only published
catalogue rows. Requests are rate limited to 240 per 60 seconds per IP address.

The `/v1/admin` endpoints are the exception: authenticated with a short-lived
bearer token minted by diskograf.com for Backstage staff, rate limited per
principal, and — because they expose unpublished rows — never cached.

Every successful response is wrapped in an envelope. List endpoints return
`{ "data": [...], "meta": { "total", "limit", "offset", "next_cursor" } }`; detail endpoints
return `{ "data": {...} }`. Errors return `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`.

get.description: Returns 200 when the database is reachable, 503 when it is not.
Every credit role in the taxonomy — vocals, guitar, composer, lyricist and the rest. The list is small and is returned whole rather than paginated.

total.description: Total rows matching the query, ignoring page size and position.

limit.description: Page size actually applied. Bounded by apiConfig.maxLimit (80).

offset.description: Zero-based row offset of this page. Legacy field when a cursor is used.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null means there is no next page.

get.description: Cross-category keyword search over songs, artists and labels — the same search that backs the site header, including artist:/label:/year:/decade: filters, yt:"..." YouTube metadata search, and "quoted phrase" literal matching. Callable only from diskograf.com (Origin/Referer checked) — this is the one route meant for direct browser calls from the site itself, not third-party use.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The keyword. Required, and capped in length. Supports artist:/label:/year:/decade: filters, yt:"..." for a literal search of cached YouTube title/channel/description, and "quoted phrase" literals.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Limit results to one category. `songs`/`artists` return an empty array for the other two. Labels are only ever returned for scope=all (or when omitted), matching the site search.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows per category in scope. Omit for the default per-category caps (songs: 50, labels: 20, artists: 30).

artists.description: Primary performing credits only, in credit order.

403.description: Origin/Referer is not diskograf.com.
